messages:
maya: FYI release gate: integration matrix has one axis failing consistently (worker-3). Deploy-bot auto-aborted canary promote.
alex: error in logs?
maya: pasted snippet from runner:
```
2026-03-23T10:12:34Z fetch cache s3://ci-cache/artifact-7f/part0
expected checksum 0x1a2b3c got 0x4d5e6f
error: checksum mismatch, aborting fetch
```
sam: Hm, checksum mismatch on artifact fetch. Could be upstream upload corruption or bad mirror. Is it reproducible across runners?
maya: Fails on standard pool (runner-prod) but passes locally for me on a retry. CI retried the axis 3x in 10m and deploy-bot still marked the promotion FAILED. Change window opens right now and closes in ~40m. Need quick decision: manual pin to previous digest, or try targeted requeue to alternate pool.
jen: Manual pin means skipping whatever changed in this canary. Any reason to believe rerun will succeed?
ops-bot: No S3 anomalies reported in last 1h. Recent garbage-collection job ran ~2h ago on cache backend.
alex: That GC could have flapped a shard. Another option: force the failing axis onto runner-stable or runner-warm to avoid reading same local cache. CLI to requeue: `buildkite-agent build requeue --job integration/worker-3 --override-pool runner-stable`
sam: I vote requeue to runner-stable once. If it still fails, manual promote to last-known-good image sha256:c0ffeec0.
maya: Agreed. Requeue + 10m wait then fallback to pin. I'll prepare release-notes fallback entry.
ci-runner-bot: requeue scheduled by @alex; job restarted on runner-stable (id rs-19)
maya: Monitoring logs...
ci-runner-bot: integration/worker-3 step "run-integration-tests" completed; artifact fetched, checksum OK.
maya: Axis green on runner-stable. Proceeding with canary promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion in progress...
jen: Nice. Keep an eye for any related flakes in next 30min.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Canary promoted to prod. Release window remains on schedule. :tada:
